reference: Independent python implementation of EN ISO 6946:2017 (R, U, Table 7 surface resistances, Table D.1 air layers, 6.7 combined method, 6.9.4 ventilated cavities), EN ISO 13788:2012 (Annex E saturation vapour pressure, clause 6 Glaser construction and annual balance, clause 4.2 humidity classes) and EN ISO 13786:2017 Annex A (dynamic response), plus two published worked U-value examples.
reference_citations: EN ISO 6946:2017, Table 7 (surface resistances), Table D.1 (unventilated air layers), 6.6, 6.7, 6.9.4
EN ISO 13788:2012, clause 4.2, clause 6, Annex E (E.1, E.2, E.3)
EN ISO 13786:2017, Annex A (heat transfer matrix, periodic thermal transmittance, areal heat capacity, time shift)
u-value.com, "How to calculate U-values: the ISO 6946 method with worked examples", Examples 1 and 2 (accessed 2026-08-11)
CoolProp 8.0.0 IAPWS-95 saturation pressure, used only as a cross-check of the ISO 13788 Annex E correlation (see crosscheck)
tolerance: display-limited: every quantity is compared to half of the last digit the tool prints (U, R, fRsi, layer R: 5e-4; interface temperatures: 0.05 K; psat: 1 Pa; condensation rate: 0.05 g/(m2 d); annual accumulation: 0.5 g/m2)

crosscheck.what: EN ISO 13788 Annex E (E.1) saturation vapour pressure vs CoolProp 8.0.0 (IAPWS-95) saturation pressure of water, 0-40 C
crosscheck.note: E.1 is a fitted Magnus expression, not an equation of state; the deviation below is the correlation own scatter and is NOT used to grade the tool - the tool is graded on implementing E.1/E.2 faithfully. Below 0 C there is no liquid saturation branch in CoolProp, so E.2 is not cross-checked.
